A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

TIMP- 1 induces an EMT-like process in MDCK cells independent of its MMP- inhibitory domain, and this process is accompanied by upregulation of MT1- MMP expression, leading to MMP-2 activation, contributing to tumor invasion.
TIMP- 1 functions as a key regulator for the EMT-like conversion and tumor cell invasion.
TIMP- 1 acts as a signaling molecule that induces EMT, and also as an MMP inhibitor that potentiates MT-MMP/MMP2 axis, leading to tumor cell migration and invasion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TIMP- 1 is a key player in the EMT process in MDCK cells, and that TIMP-2 may be a better candidate for targeting the MT1-MMP/ MMP-2 axis.
TIMP- 1 may be a potential target for cancer therapy.
TIMP-2 is a more potent inhibitor of MT1-MPP/MMP-2 than TIMP-1.
